==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champion to play is {{ci|Thresh}}.
* He has tattoos, which was visibly shown on his streams.
* His role model in League of Legends is [[TusiN]].
* In 2023 he had announced he was temporarily quitting being a progamer in a tweet to address his health conditions. He afterwards returned to play in [[paiN Gaming]].<ref>[https://twitter.com/KuriLoL_/status/1666580943195504642 Kuri's Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* Was featured on a '''LoL Esports Top 5 Plays of the Week''' as '''Top 1''' playing for [[paiN Gaming]] with his 5-men {{ci|alistar}} engage against [[FURIA]].<ref>[https://x.com/lolesports/status/1808516057214357988 LoL Esports' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Is the second Korean player in the history of CBLOL to changes his residency to Brazil, only after [[Wizer]].
===Individual Awards===
* 1x CBLOL 1st All-Pro Team (2024 Split 1)
* 1x CBLOL 1st Round-Robin Team (2024 Split 2)
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 100 games played with [[TitaN]] in April 21st, 2025.<ref>[https://x.com/LTASul/status/1914363215687110747 LTA Sul's X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
